game_concept: A card battler set in Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway, rope walkways in the canopy: the fairy gardener must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Times Table Garden: Plant a grid of healing herbs using nested for loops for rows and columns.
theme: Mystic Forest – Canopy Walkway: rope walkways in the canopy
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Object-like macros: build a valid C source file that prints 11. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the router at (3, 3), with the upper processing path on row 1 and lower path on row 6. IF item value >= 12, send north to the upper branch; ELSE send south to the lower branch. Assemble components on both paths, then merge them at (8, 3) before the shared output. Deliver exactly 7 components (4 upper, 3 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 7.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Times Table Garden' (Week 5 slot 6), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Canopy Walkway'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about garden_cells to power up the fairy gardener and open the vine bridge.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
source_game_title: Times Table Garden – Canopy Walkway Streak
hint: IF item value >= 12, send north to the upper branch; ELSE send south to the lower branch. Assemble components on both paths, then merge them at (8, 3) before the shared output. Branch contracts: IF: 4 components via upper_4, upper_6 to output_shared; ELSE: 3 components via lower_4, lower_6 to output_shared. Power the junctions and production machines.
